known_limitations: No validated obstacle-triggered automatic stop; policy minimum target speed is 1 m/s.
Normal deceleration limiting may delay slowing before a corner or obstacle.
Invalid-scan stops currently clear when valid scans resume; no latched rearm.
No VESC-state freshness watchdog in the policy node.
Ground speed and physical steering angle require independent calibration.
Small positive servo-command saturation was observed.
Raw datasets, videos and rosbag files remain local and are not included in this commit.
next_checks: Calibrate physical steering angle and independent ground speed.
Review collision-stop/rearm and stale-controller telemetry behavior before higher-speed testing.

user_observation.source: User visual observation; no automated lap counter or ground-truth pose in bag.

limitations: About six laps is user-reported, not independently counted from this bag.
A fault-free recording does not establish collision-free operation on other tracks or at other speeds.
Wheel-derived odometry is not an independent measurement of true ground speed.
Servo saturation remains; no independent wheel-angle calibration in this session.
Temperature fields are not populated by this ROS driver.
Existing close-obstacle, automatic rearm and stale-VESC telemetry limitations remain.
ROS shutdown command delivery and physical stopping distance are not validated by this bag.
